references.text: Jesus confirms the same principle: Knowing the Father is conditioned on knowing the Son, and vice versa.
Jesus states that whoever sees Him sees the Father, and that faith in Him is faith in the Father.
Jesus describes the enemy's condition as not knowing either the Father or Himself.
Jesus emphasizes that honor for the Father is tied to honor for the Son, and that no one knows the Father except the Son.
John summarizes the theology: Whoever does not have the Son does not have the Father, and whoever has the Son also has the Father.
